# inference-recipes

> Reproducible, tuned LLM serving recipes and Pareto benchmarks (https://kkr16.github.io/inference-recipes/)

## Recipes
- Qwen3.8-27B on rtx-pro-6000 (DP=8 x TP=1, vLLM 0.34.0 FP8): c=1 E2E p90=4.91s, Peak=2,550.3 tok/s (DP=8 @ c=8/GPU) [https://github.com/kkr16/inference-recipes/tree/main/models/qwen3.8-27b/rtx-pro-6000/recipes/tp1-vllm-fp8-mtp4]
- Qwen3.8-27B on rtx-pro-6000 (DP=8 x TP=1, vLLM 0.34.0 NVFP4): c=1 E2E p90=46.19s, Peak=29,699.1 tok/s (DP=8 @ c=64/GPU) [https://github.com/kkr16/inference-recipes/tree/main/models/qwen3.8-27b/rtx-pro-6000/recipes/tp1-vllm-nvfp4-dyn-mtp]
- Qwen3.8-27B on rtx-pro-6000 (DP=8 x TP=1, vLLM 0.34.0 NVFP4): c=1 E2E p90=3.75s, Peak=4,106.9 tok/s (DP=8 @ c=16/GPU) [https://github.com/kkr16/inference-recipes/tree/main/models/qwen3.8-27b/rtx-pro-6000/recipes/tp1-vllm-nvfp4-mtp4-mode3]
- Qwen3.8-27B on rtx-pro-6000 (DP=8 x TP=1, vLLM 0.34.0 NVFP4): c=1 E2E p90=3.86s, Peak=4,172.4 tok/s (DP=8 @ c=24/GPU) [https://github.com/kkr16/inference-recipes/tree/main/models/qwen3.8-27b/rtx-pro-6000/recipes/tp1-vllm-nvfp4-mtp4]
